title: ‘Bad’ Florida Mom Brings Her Kid on Police Chase
description:
Bodycam footage shows a Florida woman being arrested for leading police on a slow-speed chase in Lake County. Eustis police said Michelle Harbin refused to pull over when an officer signaled his emergency lights. Harbin was driving on a suspended license. The 37-year-old mom escalated the situation, claiming she was taking her son to the hospital and could not stop. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
